Name: Tent Kit Craft
Author: 970B
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Tent Kit Craft (Stardew 1.6+)[/b][/size][/center]
Adds a crafting recipe for the [b]Tent Kit[/b] to the game so you can start your wilderness adventures early!
[line]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Recipe[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]50 Wood[/b]
[*] [b]20 Fiber[/b]
[*] [b]10 Hardwood[/b]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]🚀 How to Unlock[/b][/size]
Once the mod is installed, [b]walk out of your farmhouse door[/b] to receive the recipe instantly.
[line]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch the game using SMAPI.
[line]
[size=4][b]👥 Multiplayer[/b][/size]
[*] Works in Multiplayer! 
[*] [b]Note:[/b] It is recommended that all players install the mod to ensure the recipe displays correctly for everyone.
[line]
[size=4][b]📝 Compatibility[/b][/size]
[*] Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*] Works with existing save files.

Manifest.Name: Instant Tent Kit
Manifest.Description: Automatically unlocks the Tent Kit recipe.
